development_scope: Existing eight correlated model-selection validation slices/four parents; three methods/all24 blocks, no new geology, held-out arrays, tuning, or model selection. Reproduces a bounded cost question after prior development outcomes were inspected.
method_order: rotate METHODS by (repetition + case_index) modulo 3; repetition outermost
cache_rule: new independent physics/POD/coarse-engine/certifier objects for every method/case/repetition; no warm diagnostic
timing_scope: single-process cold per-model solver caches, not process/OS/CPU-cache cold; no concurrent task-owned compute
clock: time.perf_counter wall time; setup constructor interval, public query interval, and their total; receipts/validation/output/teardown outside core time
setup_rule: Include each new Helmholtz instance and applicable POD constructor (basis copy/orthogonality Gram, stiffness and damping projections) and coarse engine/certifier constructor (two damping DCT-I transforms). Separately report setup and query, as well as total cold.
query_rule: Include all per-model mass projections, exact factor/solve routes, reduced solves/lifts, model DCTs, small SVD/eigen/inverse RHS, receiver and correction work, physical-gradient contractions, and certificate context/result construction performed by the existing API. No model/factor/receiver caches shared across cold calls.
common_work_rule: Preload and audit identical fixture/basis before timing; prepare identical model/block arrays once. Independently recompute fine validation on another solver outside core times; report its wall time/work and retain historical teacher-generation and basis-fit costs. Write output only between complete rotated triples.
task_difference: Exact objective/full gradient; approximate raw POD objective/gradient; corrected physical proposal plus deterministic directional bound in the documented ordinary-floating-point scope. These are different tasks. No equal-accuracy, inversion, time-to-target, native-64 or field-scale speedup claim.
summary_rule: Raw paired times by repetition/slice; four-parent descriptive summaries. No IID-eight confidence interval. No optional warm diagnostic.
